# workflows

`verify-chain.yml` runs `scripts/verify-ensemble.sh`. Private names (`arakelov-rh-descent` and the other three) are skipped. The check records public core `da3b943c662f` against the CHAIN.md lock `6ec00281c55d` and requires the local `Towers/` modules. The old HTTP 404 is in [`docs/OPERA_VERIFY_ENSEMBLE_FAIL.md`](../../docs/OPERA_VERIFY_ENSEMBLE_FAIL.md).
